notes.title: The playtest is now open to all!
notes.notes: [p]The people of Sea, Sun & Salt playtest is now open.[/p][p][/p][p] To play, simply go the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617200/The_people_of_Sea_Sun__Salt/"]steam page[/url] and click "JOIN PLAYTEST".  The game is still in its early stages and we are looking for both fans of the city builder genre and casual enthouthiast to try out the game. Your experience and feedback will be invaluable and allow us to make the best version of the game possible. [/p][p][/p][p]The playtest is entirely free so get in and get a first ever peek into our brand new city builder.[/p][p][/p][p]You will be prompted to give feedback in game but feel free to join our discord to discuss things you like, things you like a little bit less and any issue you are having: [url="https://discord.gg/vdpcGMf4Nj"]https://discord.gg/vdpcGMf4Nj[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Looking forward to seeing the astonishing cities you will create! [/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3617200/partnerevents/preview/738149224958394446"]Preview Event[/url][/p]

notes.title: Art & Awnings
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,  [/p][p]We are entering a new stage of development: polishing the game's art and dealing with annoying bugs.[/p][h3]Awnings[/h3][p]I am iterating through the building art a little, the big improvement being animated awnings. In these remote islands, the wind brushes the countryside constantly. It's unrelenting and I wanted this to appear in almost all parts of the game's art: Everything that isn't very solid sways with the wind. The trees, the grass, the fields, everything.[/p][p]And to increase that effect, I decided to add little awnings on most buildings. They produce well needed shade and move with every gust of wind.[/p][p]It also adds a touch of color to the gameIt's the little things that make the difference at this point.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569365/889e2c9ea501507cb8a0d3b512d1be200966d8db.png"][/img][/p][h3]Card art[/h3][p]A big update on the game's 2D art assets is coming. It probably won't be ready for the first open playtest but it will be a well needed improvement to the game: I'm not a professional 2D artist so it was very lucky for me to find an artist willing to rework all the cards and all of the UI. I wanted to share a little sneak peek of some of that progress[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45569365/db2425acd14871e87cdcfebba59036e4520ac541.png"][/img][/p][h3]End game bugs & QA[/h3][p]As a developer you always dread these types of bugs. The ones that happen toward the end of the game when you have thousands of buildings, thousands of NPCs and it is very hard to figure out what part of your sprawling civilization is causing the issue. You have to spend hours trying to find the exact condition triggering the issue, sift through month old code. Sea, Sun & Salt was not spared. [/p][p]Luckily, Rock Game's very efficient QA team caught the issue and we managed to solve it. The game has now been thoroughly tested and it is almost ready to land in [b]your[/b] hands![/p][h3]Joining october Next Fest![/h3][p]And finally, The people of Sea, Sun & Salt will appear in this October's Next Fest. We're all looking forward to seeing the game tried out by eager city building fans and hearing all of the feedback and the (hopefully) constructive criticism.[/p][p]Stay posted by joining our discord server: [url="https://discord.gg/MyurZwEX"]https://discord.gg/MyurZwEX[/url]  [/p][p]Stay tuned![/p]

notes.title: Publisher announcement
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,  [/p][p]I'm proud to announce that I have entered in a publishing agreement with RockGame for The people of Sea, Sun & Salt!  [/p][p]RockGame is a renowned and experienced team in the gaming industry, and I believe their expertise will help me elevate The people of Sea, Sun & Salt to new heights. Their support will enable me to focus more on developing the game and bringing you an even more immersive and captivating civilization building experience!  [/p][p]In addition, their collaboration will enable me to bring the game to a new level of quality thanks to their expertise and resources.  [/p][p]Throughout my partnership with RockGame, I'll keep you updated on the progress, exciting developments, and all the new features coming to The people of Sea, Sun & Salt. RockGame and I am committed to making this game the best it can be and bringing you a unique city building experience.  [/p][p]The game is progressing apace so follow the game's Steam page to get posted on future updates and possible playtests opportunities. And make sure to wishlist it!  [/p][p]We have just created a discord server so make sure to join if you want to discuss all things "The people of Sea, Sun & Salt": [url="https://discord.gg/MyurZwEX"]https://discord.gg/MyurZwEX[/url]  [/p][p]Stay tuned![/p]
